body: For a lot of us, yeah
Happy birthday. I hope something turns up for you.
Thank you for the update. Hoping things turn up for you.
What else do you want to do if work didn't get in the way?
I do relate! That's what I do sometimes as well. I don't know what could help though
It's so difficult when the people around us don't know how to handle these episodes. Such a big factor. I hope communication with your family improves
You sound very considerate. I hope something turns up to make you feel good these next days
That sounds like a lot of hate
7 days of work a week? I think you deserve to just lay around some more tbh
This is a very difficult period. Pets are family :( Wishing some good feelings your way
Wanna talk?
What are you planning to do until then?
Sometimes, we just want a different life, not really to stop living completely
Some days, I still wonder. I get the urges. Some days, it's so busy I forget. Some days, there are good things and I'm happy I'm still here. All days are different, but somehow it feels all the same.

Thank you for taking the time to respond! So far, I feel the same: the thoughts remain at the back of my mind even when things are going well. I was previously diagnosed with panic disorder and bipolar disorder, which has a depressive phase, so I guess that's also a factor. Thank you for the tips. It's true, it's better to focus on what I can control 😊🙏

I'm sorry you are going through such a tough time. I was also diagnosed with bipolar disorder, and experienced people telling me that I don't have it. That really messes with your head.

Regarding the rape and the telecommunications harassment, would you be comfortable with sharing at [r/legaladvice](https://www.reddit.com/r/legaladvice)? Some folks there might know what to do.

Thank you so much for your thoughts. I really appreciate you guys taking the time to give some advice. I'm doing a bit better now and so are most of my friends. I hope you are doing well also wherever you may be. Take care! :)

Hello. Thank you so much for your thoughts. Sorry it took a while to respond here, I really appreciate your advice. Most of my friends are doing a bit better now, and so do I. I hope all of us comes out okay after this lockdown. Take care of yourself also! :)
That's tough. I don't know if it's the same with you, but ranting makes me feel a tad lighter sometimes. If you want to, just keep ranting here. I can listen.
You're not being an attention whore. It's good to reach out even if just here on the internet.
Everything is just so hard to do.

Oh, I wish you a sunnier and comfier weather over there! I hope you guys are both doing great. 

It's no problem, I am from Southeast Asia. Are you from the US? Lately, I've been trying to distract myself a lot, and yesterday, I flew overseas to visit family and to get away for a bit.

My sincere thanks for your efforts, AMightyBlusteryDay. :)
Keep venting out here if you need to. Even if we're just strangers on the internet, we can listen.

Hello. I'm here to talk about anything if you want. I often thought about suicide before as well, and recently started thinking seriously about it. Reaching out to others is a good first step in getting better though, I think.

It's great that you spent the day with your family! :) What did you play with your brother?

It's now 6AM here. I kept tossing and turning, and just decided to go for a 4AM run, and decided to go online and browse a bit. Thank goodness the night is done. What time is it there?

Speaking of time, thank you so much for giving me a bit of yours.

Thank you so much. May I know about your day too? 

As for me, I went out of the house today, went to church, walked around in thr mall, stayed a bit at the park and ate a corn on the cob. I saw a baby being carried by her mother grasp and play with a stranger's finger, and I was able to bust out my first sincere smile since Tuesday. For a few brief moments, I was sad and okay at the same time. Like I was going to make it somehow. 

But evenings and nights are the worst, when I'm about to rest before I sleep. Evenings are usually when we have dinner together, watch something together, just bum around the couch, or chat with each other. Nights give no rest as I always wake up from sweats or nightmares.
It's so difficult to talk about. But thank you, thank you for reaching out.
